purpose: Reusable motion base. Generated ONCE, reused across all 51 of Diane's courses and every application video she presents. A new base is required only if Roger changes her approved appearance - that would be a new client approval.

input.prompt: A professional woman seated at her desk in a dark, refined private office, holding still and listening between takes. She is NOT speaking: her lips stay closed and together for the entire clip. Natural involuntary blinking at a relaxed human rate. Subtle breathing and very small, organic head-posture settling. Her hands stay exactly as they are, folded and still on the desk. The camera is locked off on a tripod: no zoom, no push-in, no pan, no tilt, no handheld drift, no parallax. Preserve the existing lighting, contrast, colour and mood exactly as in the source image; do not brighten, lift the shadows, or re-grade. No change whatsoever to her face, hair, wardrobe, the room, the desk items, or the framing. The framed plaque and the mug keep their existing lettering unchanged. One continuous locked-off shot, no cuts, no transitions.
input.negative_prompt: speaking, talking, mouth opening, lip movement, gesturing, hand movement, standing, leaning, camera movement, zoom, push-in, pan, tilt, reframing, crop, scene change, cut, transition, wardrobe change, hairstyle change, face change, lighting change, room change, brightening, re-grading, added text, added captions, added logos, added graphics, overlays, watermark, extra people, distortion, warping, morphing

no_seed_parameter: kling/v2-1-pro exposes no seed parameter. This clip is NOT reproducible; it is the artifact of record. Preserve it.
fps_note: Base is 24 fps. LatentSync normalises output to 25 fps regardless of input, so the 16-frame padding must be computed at 25 fps (locked rule 3). Same as Selena's base.
